absorb.title_zh: DS5319 Rev 20 表 16、表 18 和表 26 的电流与唤醒时间
absorb.title_en: DS5319 Rev 20 Tables 16, 18, and 26 current and wake-up time
absorb.snapshot: DS5319 Rev 20, July 2025. Table 16 typical values at TA = 25°C and VDD = 3.3 V, in this condition order: Stop with the main regulator running, internal RC and HSE off, and no independent watchdog, 24 µA; the same conditions with the regulator in low-power mode, 14 µA; Standby with LSI and IWDG on, 3.4 µA; Standby with LSI on and IWDG off, 3.2 µA; Standby with LSI, IWDG, LSE, and RTC off, 2 µA; backup domain with LSE and RTC on, 1.4 µA, which is IDD_VBAT and not the whole-chip Standby current. The 85°C Stop maximums are the printed 200 µA and 180 µA, not typical values. Table 18: Sleep at 72 MHz is 14.4 mA typical with all peripherals on and 5.5 mA typical with all peripherals off, at 25°C and 3.3 V. Table 26: Sleep 1.8 µs on the clock that was already running; Stop with the main regulator 3.6 µs; Stop with the low-power regulator 5.4 µs; Standby 50 µs. Stop and Standby times are measured on the 8 MHz HSI until the first user instruction. Sleep keeps the clock from before the sleep. Table 27 tLOCK maximum is 200 µs and is not added to 5.4 µs. Section 2.3.12: Stop exits on EXTI; Standby exits on NRST, IWDG, a rising edge on WKUP, or the RTC alarm; SRAM is lost in Standby. If a printed cell differs, replace the cell and say so in the implementation PR. This snapshot does not record a combined Stop range, and does not call 1.4 µA the whole-chip standby current.

points: At 3.3 V and 25°C the low-power-regulator Stop cell is 14 µA and the main-regulator cell is 24 µA. Both cells exclude the independent watchdog
Standby is 3.4, 3.2, or 2 µA according to LSI and IWDG. 1.4 µA is the backup domain
Sleep is 14.4 mA or 5.5 mA. Wake-up is 1.8, 3.6, 5.4, or 50 µs. tLOCK at 200 µs is not the wake-up time

absorb.title_zh: RM0008 Rev 21 退出 Stop 后回到 HSI
absorb.title_en: RM0008 Rev 21 returns to HSI when Stop exits
absorb.snapshot: RM0008 Rev 21, February 2021. Default the power-control chapter. After entering Stop, clocks in the 1.8 V domain stop and HSI, HSE, and the PLL are off. On leaving Stop the system clock is HSI and the clock configuration has to be programmed again. PDDS = 0 and SLEEPDEEP = 1 is Stop. PDDS = 1 and SLEEPDEEP = 1 is Standby. The low-power regulator is the printed LPDS bit. If the printed chapter title or bit names differ, use the printed text. The claim does not change: exit from Stop is HSI, and the clock setup must be restored before the next USART byte. This snapshot does not restate the 8 MHz HSI calibration from chapter 02 and does not include an F4 periodic wake-up timer.

points: Leaving Stop returns the system clock to HSI. Program the PLL again before the next byte
PDDS = 0 and SLEEPDEEP = 1 is Stop. PDDS = 1 and SLEEPDEEP = 1 is Standby
The F4 periodic wake-up timer is not in this chapter

absorb.title_zh: PM0056 的 DEMCR bit 24 与 DWT 周期计数
absorb.title_en: PM0056 DEMCR bit 24 and the DWT cycle counter
absorb.snapshot: PM0056, the same PDF as pm0056-nvic. DEMCR is at 0xE000EDFC. Bit 24 enables trace. After that bit is set, DWT_CYCCNT at 0xE0001004 counts. At 72 MHz, 72 counts are 1 µs. If bit 24 is clear, the counter stays at 0 and a delta reads 0. If the printed bit is not 24, record the printed bit and keep the printed addresses. Cortex-M3 hardware breakpoint comparators default to 6. The M7 count of 8 is void on this C8. This snapshot does not restate the four fault addresses already in pm0056, does not copy the tail-chaining interval from chapter 04, and does not invent a data-watchpoint count or an FPB base address.

points: Set DEMCR bit 24 before reading DWT_CYCCNT. A clear bit reads a delta of 0
This Cortex-M3 has 6 hardware breakpoint comparators. 8 is void on the C8
